name: Aloo Tomato Curry
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes. Chop the tomatoes and slice the chilies.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the chilies for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cook for 5 minutes until soft and mushy.
Add the potatoes, stir well, cover, and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are tender.
Add salt to taste and serve hot.

name: Masala Potato
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1.5 cm cubes. Slice the onions and chilies.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the onions and chilies for about 5 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the potatoes and salt, and stir to coat them.
Cook covered on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often so the potatoes do not stick.
Uncover and cook 5 more minutes until the potatoes are golden and tender. Serve hot.

name: Tomato Chili Soup
instructions: Roughly chop the tomatoes and the chili.
Put them in a pot with the water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 10 minutes until the tomatoes are very soft.
Blend until smooth, return to the pot, and season with salt. Reheat for 2 minutes and serve.

name: Spicy Potato Toast
instructions: Cook the potatoes until soft (boil or steam them), then peel them.
Mash the potatoes with the finely chopped chili and salt.
Spread the mixture evenly over the bread slices.
Toast under a grill or in a toaster oven for 3-4 minutes until the edges are crisp. Serve warm.

name: Simple Tomato Rice
instructions: Chop the onion and tomatoes, and slice the chilies.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for about 4 minutes until soft.
Add the chilies, tomatoes, and salt. Cook for 8 minutes until the tomatoes turn pulpy.
Add the cooked rice and mix gently for 3 minutes until heated through. Serve hot.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Dice the carrot and onion. Make sure the cooked rice is cool and not clumpy.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil, scramble the eggs until just set, and move them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil to the pan and fry the onion and carrot for 4 minutes. Add the peas and cook 2 more minutes.
Add the rice and salt, and stir-fry on high heat for 4 minutes.
Fold the scrambled eggs back in and serve immediately.

name: Egg Curry
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them in cold water, and peel them.
Finely chop the onions and tomatoes, and slice the chilies.
Heat the oil and fry the onions for about 6 minutes until golden.
Add the chilies, turmeric, tomatoes, and salt. Cook for 8 minutes until the mixture is thick and the oil separates.
Add the whole boiled eggs, turn them to coat in the masala, and cook 3 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Masoor Dal
instructions: Rinse the lentils until the water runs mostly clear.
Boil the lentils with the water and turmeric for 15-20 minutes until completely soft, skimming off any foam.
Meanwhile, chop the onion and tomatoes and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil, fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the onion and cook 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until mushy.
Stir the fried mixture and salt into the dal and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Masala Omelette
instructions: Finely chop the onion and chili.
Beat the eggs with salt, then stir in the onion and chili.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and pour in the mixture.
Cook for 2 minutes until the base is set, flip, and cook 1-2 more minutes. Serve hot.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
instructions: Toast the bread slices.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat, pour in the eggs, and stir gently for 2-3 minutes until softly set.
Spoon the eggs onto the toast and serve right away.

name: Cheese Toast
instructions: Heat the grill. Grate the cheese.
Lightly butter one side of each bread slice and grill the unbuttered sides for 1 minute.
Turn the slices over, pile the cheese on the buttered sides, and grill 3-4 minutes until melted and bubbling. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Bhurji
instructions: Crumble the paneer with your hands. Finely chop the onion, tomato, and chilies.
Heat the oil and fry the onion for 4 minutes until soft. Add the chilies and cook 1 minute.
Add the tomato, turmeric, and salt, and cook 3 minutes until soft.
Add the crumbled paneer and cook for 4 minutes, stirring, until heated through. Serve hot.

name: Palak Paneer
instructions: Wash the spinach well. Cook it covered in a pan over medium heat for 4-5 minutes until wilted, then blend to a coarse puree.
Cut the paneer into cubes. Finely chop the onion and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil and brown the paneer cubes lightly for 3-4 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then the onion for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the spinach puree and salt, and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the paneer and simmer 3 more minutes. Serve hot.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onions and tomatoes, and crush the garlic and ginger together into a paste.
Heat the oil and fry the onions for 8 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic-ginger paste and cook 1 minute, then add the turmeric and tomatoes. Cook 6 minutes until the tomatoes break down.
Add the chicken and salt, and stir for 5 minutes to seal the pieces.
Pour in the water, cover, and simmer 20-25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick. Serve hot.

name: Khichdi
instructions: Rinse the rice and lentils together until the water runs mostly clear.
Put them in a pot with the water, turmeric, and salt, and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft and porridge-like.
Stir in the oil and serve hot.

name: Tomato Garlic Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Chop the tomatoes and slice the garlic. Grate the cheese.
Heat the oil, cook the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Simmer 10 minutes until saucy.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and serve topped with the cheese.

name: Aloo Jeera
instructions: Boil the whole potatoes for about 15 minutes until just tender, then cool, peel, and cut into cubes.
Heat the oil and add the cumin. Let it sizzle for 20 seconds.
Add the turmeric, potatoes, and salt.
Fry for 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden at the edges. Serve hot.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks, and boil in salted water for 15-20 minutes until very tender. Drain well.
Warm the milk with the butter until the butter melts.
Mash the potatoes, then beat in the milk and butter until smooth. Add salt to taste.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Peel and dice the carrots, potatoes, and onion.
Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion for 3 minutes. Add the carrots and potatoes and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the water and salt, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Mash a few pieces against the side of the pot to thicken the soup slightly. Serve hot.

name: Cucumber Raita
instructions: Dry-roast the cumin in a pan for 1 minute, then crush it.
Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the extra liquid.
Whisk the yogurt until smooth and stir in the cucumber, cumin, and salt.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Cucumber Tomato Salad
instructions: Dice the cucumber and tomatoes. Slice the onion thinly.
Toss everything together in a bowl with salt.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve.

name: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mash the bananas well in a bowl.
Whisk in the eggs, milk, and sugar, then fold in the flour until just combined.
Melt a little of the butter in a pan over medium heat and pour in about a quarter cup of batter.
Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip, and cook 1-2 minutes more. Repeat with the remaining butter and batter. These pancakes come out thin and soft.

name: Rice Pudding
instructions: Rinse the rice.
Bring the milk to a gentle boil in a heavy pan, then add the rice.
Simmer on low heat for 30-35 minutes, stirring often so it does not stick, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and cook 5 more minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

name: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Mix the flour with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and the water. Knead for 5 minutes and rest the dough for 15 minutes.
Boil the potatoes until tender, peel, and mash them with the finely chopped chilies and salt.
Divide the dough into 8 balls. Flatten one, place a spoonful of potato filling in the middle, seal it, and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot pan with a little oil for 2-3 minutes per side until golden spots appear. Repeat with the rest. Serve hot.
